payload.name: 1A Invoices & Payments - Number of suppliers
payload.query: SELECT json_build_object('countSuppliers', json_agg(t.countSuppliers)) FROM ( SELECT COUNT("vendorId") as countSuppliers FROM infra_vendor) t;

payload.name: 1B Invoices & Payments - Invoice Amounts
payload.query: SELECT json_build_object('approveTotal', json_agg(t.approveTotal),'paidTotal', json_agg(t.paidTotal),'draftTotal', json_agg(t.draftTotal)) FROM (SELECT SUM(CAST("billTotal" ->> 'total' AS FLOAT)) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'APPROVE') as approveTotal, SUM(CAST("billTotal" ->> 'total' AS FLOAT)) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'PAID') as paidTotal, SUM(CAST("billTotal" ->> 'total' AS FLOAT)) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'DRAFT') as draftTotal FROM infra_invoices WHERE "status" IN ('APPROVE', 'PAID', 'DRAFT')) t;

payload.name: 1C Invoices & Payments - Invoice Amounts Monthly
payload.query: SELECT json_build_object('yearMonth', json_agg(t.yearMonth),'approveTotal', json_agg(t.approveTotal),'paidTotal', json_agg(t.paidTotal),'draftTotal', json_agg(t.draftTotal)) FROM(SELECT year * 100 + month as yearMonth,SUM(CAST("billTotal" ->> 'total' AS FLOAT)) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'APPROVE') as approveTotal,SUM(CAST("billTotal" ->> 'total' AS FLOAT)) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'PAID') as paidTotal,SUM(CAST("billTotal" ->> 'total' AS FLOAT)) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'DRAFT') as draftTotal FROM infra_invoices WHERE "status" IN ('APPROVE', 'PAID', 'DRAFT') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC) t;

payload.name: 1D Invoices & Payments - Invoice Details
payload.query: SELECT json_agg(t) FROM ( SELECT iv."vendorId" as vendorId, ii."billId" as billId, iv."payload" ->> 'name' as vendorName, ii."status" as invoiceStatus, ii."year" as invoiceYear, ii."month" as invoiceMonth, SUM(CAST(ii."billTotal" ->> 'total' AS FLOAT)) AS billTotal FROM infra_invoices ii JOIN infra_vendor iv ON ii."vendorId_id" = iv.id  WHERE ii."status" IN ('APPROVE', 'PAID', 'DRAFT') GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6) t;

payload.name: 2A Orders - Summary
payload.query: SELECT json_build_object('ordersCreated', json_agg(t.ordersCreated), 'ordersAmount', json_agg(t.ordersAmount), 'orderItems', json_agg(t.orderItems), 'itemsProcessing', json_agg(t.itemsProcessing), 'itemsShipped', json_agg(t.itemsShipped), 'itemsDelivered', json_agg(t.itemsDelivered), 'itemsCanceled', json_agg(t.itemsCanceled)) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT B."id") AS ordersCreated, SUM("billingAmount") AS ordersAmount, COUNT(A."id") AS orderItems, COUNT(CASE WHEN "recentStatus" IN ('created', 'picked', 'sortdrop', 'packed') THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS itemsProcessing, COUNT(CASE WHEN "recentStatus" IN ('shipped', 'AGENT ASSIGNED', 'OUT FOR DELIVERY') THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS itemsShipped, COUNT(CASE WHEN "recentStatus" IN ('delivered', 'DELIVERED') THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS itemsDelivered, COUNT(CASE WHEN "recentStatus" = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS itemsCanceled FROM public.infra_orderitems AS A JOIN public.infra_orders AS B ON A."orderId_id" = B.id) t;

payload.name: 2B Orders - Order Items Trend
payload.query: SELECT json_build_object('orderYearMonth', json_agg(t.orderYearMonth), 'ordersCreated', json_agg(t.ordersCreated), 'ordersAmount', json_agg(t.ordersAmount), 'orderItems', json_agg(t.orderItems), 'itemsProcessing', json_agg(t.itemsProcessing), 'itemsShipped', json_agg(t.itemsShipped), 'itemsDelivered', json_agg(t.itemsDelivered), 'itemsCanceled', json_agg(t.itemsCanceled)) FROM (SELECT DATE_PART('year', B."createdDate") * 100 + DATE_PART('month', B."createdDate") as orderYearMonth, COUNT(DISTINCT B."id") AS ordersCreated, SUM("billingAmount") AS ordersAmount, COUNT(A."id") AS orderItems, COUNT(CASE WHEN "recentStatus" IN ('created', 'picked', 'sortdrop', 'packed') THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS itemsProcessing, COUNT(CASE WHEN "recentStatus" IN ('shipped', 'AGENT ASSIGNED', 'OUT FOR DELIVERY') THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS itemsShipped, COUNT(CASE WHEN "recentStatus" IN ('delivered', 'DELIVERED') THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS itemsDelivered, COUNT(CASE WHEN "recentStatus" = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS itemsCanceled FROM public.infra_orderitems AS A JOIN public.infra_orders AS B ON A."orderId_id" = B.id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC) t;

payload.name: 2C Orders - Details Suppliers
payload.query: SELECT json_agg(t) FROM (SELECT B."vendorId_id" AS vendorId, C."payload" ->> 'name' AS vendorName, C."billing" ->> 'model' AS vendorSubscription, (C."billing" ->> 'subscription')::json ->> 'category' AS vendorSubscriptionName, COUNT(DISTINCT B."id") AS ordersCreated, SUM("billingAmount") AS ordersAmount, COUNT(A."id") AS orderItems, COUNT(CASE WHEN "recentStatus" IN ('created', 'picked', 'sortdrop', 'packed') THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS itemsProcessing, COUNT(CASE WHEN "recentStatus" IN ('shipped', 'AGENT ASSIGNED', 'OUT FOR DELIVERY') THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS itemsShipped, COUNT(CASE WHEN "recentStatus" IN ('delivered', 'DELIVERED') THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS itemsDelivered, COUNT(CASE WHEN "recentStatus" = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS itemsCanceled FROM public.infra_orderitems AS A JOIN public.infra_orders AS B ON A."orderId_id" = B.id LEFT JOIN public.infra_vendor AS C ON B."vendorId_id" = C.id GROUP BY 1,2,3,4) t;

payload.name: 3A Inventory - Summary
payload.query: SELECT json_build_object('asnCreated', json_agg(t.asnCreated), 'grnCreated', json_agg(t.grnCreated), 'grnApproved', json_agg(t.grnApproved)) FROM (SELECT COUNT("asnId") AS asnCreated, COUNT("asnId") FILTER (WHERE "grnUpdated" = true) AS grnCreated, COUNT("asnId") FILTER (WHERE "grnConfirmed" = true) AS grnApproved FROM public.inbound_asn AS asn) t;

payload.name: 3B Inventory - Detail Suppliers
payload.query: SELECT json_agg(t) FROM( SELECT vendor.id AS vendorId, vendor."payload" ->> 'name' AS vendorName, vendor."billing" ->> 'model' AS vendorSubscription, (vendor."billing" ->> 'subscription')::json ->> 'category' AS vendorSubscriptionName, COUNT(DISTINCT sku.id) AS countSKUs, SUM("currentQuantity") AS skuQuantity, COUNT(DISTINCT "allocatedShelfId_id") AS shelvesAllocated, COUNT(DISTINCT "allocatedBinId_id") AS binsAllocated FROM public.infra_vendor AS vendor LEFT JOIN public.inbound_sku AS sku ON vendor.id = sku."vendorId_id" LEFT JOIN public.infra_inventory as inventory ON sku."skuNumber" = inventory."skuNumber" GROUP BY 1,2,3,4) t;
